description: This Java interface defines a builder pattern for creating responses to RetrieveFeatures commands within a live command processing context in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes nested interfaces for response factory methods to produce success and error responses related to feature retrieval.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface functioning as a builder for creating command responses for RetrieveFeatures commands, extending the query command response step with a nested ResponseFactory for success and error responses.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Nested interface that provides methods to generate responses indicating success with features or an error indicating features are inaccessible.

methods.name: retrieved
methods.description: Creates a success response containing the retrieved features.

methods.name: featuresNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the features are not accessible or do not exist.
